entities.summary: Filaret Mykhailovych Kolessa was a Ukrainian composer, ethnographer, folklorist, musicologist and literary critic. He was a member of the Shevchenko Scientific Society from 1909, The All-Ukrainian Academy of Sciences from 1929, and the founder of Ukrainian ethnographic musicology.
